publicationDateNote: The document explicitly states 'March 2021' in its footer (unlike the Ross 308 and Arbor Acres Plus documents, which only carry the year and a print-code date). publicationDate is set to the first of that month since no exact day is given.
notes: CANDIDATE FILE - NOT YET IMPORTED. Transcribed via pdftotext -layout from the official Indian River (slow feathering) Parent Stock Performance Objectives 2021 EN booklet. Captured: Performance Summary (liveability rows only), Female Body Weight and Feeding Program (In-Season) (out-of-season variant intentionally omitted, matching the Ross 308 profile convention), Male Body Weight and Feeding Program, Weekly Egg Production, Weekly Hatchability and Chick Production, and Weekly Egg Weight and Egg Mass. Feeding Into Lay table (Hen-Day % milestones) was not imported, matching the Ross 308 profile's treatment of the analogous table. Values are exactly as published; no interpolation or estimation. Body weight and feed values shown are metric (g); the source also publishes imperial (lb) columns which are not captured here (matches Ross 308 profile scope).

body_weight_g.table: Female Body Weight and Feeding Program (In-Season) / Male Body Weight and Feeding Program

daily_feed_intake_g.table: Female Body Weight and Feeding Program (In-Season) / Male Body Weight and Feeding Program

hen_week_production_pct.footnote: * Hen-week (%) is based on the assumption that cumulative mortality in lay is 8% with 0.2% mortality per week.
hen_week_production_pct.note: The source document has no column literally headed 'Hen-Day'. This metric is the Hen-Week (%) column verbatim. A genuine 'Hen-Day (%)' heading appears elsewhere in the PDF only on the Feeding into Lay table (a feed-by-production-milestone program keyed to 5/10/15.../75% production), which this profile does not import.

hatching_eggs_per_hen_housed_weekly.footnote: ** A hatching egg is considered to be an egg which is 50 g (21.2 oz/dozen) or heavier.

hatchability_all_eggs_weekly_pct.footnote: * Hatchability is based on an average egg age of three days. Hatchability will drop by 0.5% per day of storage between 7 and 11 days.

egg_weight_g.table: Weekly Egg Weight and Egg Mass

egg_mass_g.table: Weekly Egg Weight and Egg Mass
egg_mass_g.footnote: * Egg mass (g) = Hen-Week (%) x Egg Weight (g) / 100
